name: listVpnConnections
description: Lists site to site VPN connection gateways

params.name: domainid
params.description: List only resources belonging to the domain specified

params.name: isrecursive
params.description: Defaults to false, but if true, lists all resources from the parent specified by the domainId till leaves.

params.name: keyword
params.description: List by keyword

params.name: fordisplay
params.description: List resources by display flag; only ROOT admin is eligible to pass this parameter

params.name: listall
params.description: If set to false, list only resources belonging to the command's caller; if set to true - list resources that the caller is authorized to see. Default value is false. Resources dedicated to a project are listed only if using the projectid parameter.

params.description: ID of the VPN connection

params.description: IKE policy of the customer gateway

params.description: Which IKE Version to use, one of ike (autoselect), ikev1, or ikev2. Connections marked with 'ike' will use 'ikev2' when initiating, but accept any protocol version when responding. Defaults to ike

params.name: ipsecpsk
params.description: IPsec Preshared-Key of the customer gateway. Cannot contain newline or double quotes.

params.description: Name of this customer gateway

params.description: The domain ID associated with the gateway. If used with the account parameter returns the gateway associated with the Account for the specified domain.
